name: punk-avatar
tagline_zh: 宠物、人像、物件都能变酷炫头像，还能把风格存成模板反复用。别家只出图，这里连头像纪念卡都给你备好。
tagline_en: Turn pets, people, or objects into punk avatars, save styles as reusable prompts. Others just draw; we also craft.
desc_en: Generate avatar images and reusable avatar image prompts from the shared Punk style library for people, pets, objects, profile pictures, pet portraits, and avatar-derived keepsake cards. Use this skill to identify the subject from image or text, choose one avatar-capable style, compile the selected style atom into the avatar blueprint, save the final prompt, and generate the image when an image-ge
why_zh: 强在把风格拆成原子组件，每次生成都复用同一套蓝图，头像风格稳定不跑偏，还能顺手做纪念卡。
why_en: It decomposes styles into atomic components, reusing the same blueprint for consistent avatars and bonus keepsake cards.
